'''''Triumph of the Galactic Empire''''' was a [[Propaganda/Legends|pro]]-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created some [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Glory-class dark trooper|''Glory''-class dark trooper]] holding a [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]], with smoking ruins behind it and a corpse (presumably Rebel) reaching a hand into the air on the bottom right.. It was sometimes released separately, although a [[multi-painting]] version combining it with its pro-Rebel counterpart, ''[[Victory of the Rebel Alliance]]'', ''[[Forces Under Siege]]'', did exist.

==Behind the scenes==
''Triumph of the Galactic Empire'' was awarded to players following the release of Game Update 15. It was a random selection between two paintings for players who reactivated their accounts between February 1 and March 1 (the other painting being ''Victory of the Rebel Alliance'', although players whose accounts were in good standing before February 1 and continued to be in good standing after March 1 were rewarded with both paintings via the multi-painting, as a way to gain both paintings as a bonus. It is the only known painting under the multi-painting category within the game.

The painting has a number of "modes" that can be accessed via the "painting controls" option in the radial menu. These modes are:

*Rebel Painting - shows the Victory of the Rebel Alliance painting.
*Imperial Painting - shows the Triumph of the Galactic Empire painting.
*Cycle Paintings - will automatically switch appearance between the two paintings on a timer.
*Reflect Planetary Control - will automatically switch the painting to show the winning faction in the Planetary Control Game for the current planet.
*Reflect Galactic Control - will automatically switch the painting to show the faction that controls the galaxy.
